description: An original, jurisdiction-neutral elevator controlled cleaning, protection, restoration, and verification record for a passenger or service conveyance whose doors, leveling, controls, machine spaces, communications, inspection status, and operating restrictions require qualified review. It connects facility identity, asset-specific evidence, hazards, qualified decisions, exceptions, service status, and accountable closeout without replacing employer procedures or trade judgment.

blocks.guidance: This Elevator record organizes facts and evidence. It does not replace employer energy-control procedures, permits, manufacturer instructions, required inspection, emergency response, or qualified trade judgment. Stop and route any unsafe or uncertain condition.
blocks.label: Safety and authority boundary

sections.guidance: Open one traceable record, identify the responsible parties, and set the review route.

blocks.guidance: Check only directly observed or source-supported items; explain inaccessible, not applicable, or conflicting evidence below.
items: Car, controller, machine, disconnect, and building identifiers reconcile
Landing and car doors, gates, interlocks, sills, and closing behavior are recorded
Leveling, starting, stopping, ride quality, noise, and vibration observations are captured
Car operating panel, indicators, call stations, and floor signals are documented
Alarm, two-way communication, emergency lighting, and recall status are recorded
Machine room, control space, pit, hoistway access, keys, and barriers are controlled
Brake, governor, ropes, belts, sheaves, hydraulic equipment, or buffers are referenced
Water intrusion, oil leakage, debris, heat, odor, and housekeeping conditions are recorded
Controller faults, callbacks, entrapments, shutdowns, and repeated symptoms are linked
Required inspection, test, certificate, permit, and maintenance-control records are referenced
Jumpers, bypasses, out-of-service controls, and temporary restrictions are visible
Work is limited to qualified conveyance personnel and the authorized scope

blocks.guidance: A checked condition requires immediate protective action, a named owner, qualified review, and a final disposition.
items: Entrapment, uncontrolled movement, unintended door motion, or unsafe leveling is reported
Door interlock, gate, brake, governor, recall, alarm, or communication function may be impaired
Water, smoke, fire, oil, debris, or electrical condition affects the car, pit, hoistway, or controls
Required isolation, access control, barricade, key control, or qualified personnel is absent
An unauthorized jumper, bypass, reset, or return-to-service request is identified
Exposed energized parts, moving equipment, suspended load, or stored energy is uncontrolled
Certificate, inspection, test, permit, shutdown, or authority restriction is unresolved
Observed condition conflicts with controller logs, callback history, inspection evidence, or field status
